name: Western Australia

known.via: English Wikipedia "Western Australia (wine)" (redirects to "Western Australian wine")

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Margaret River has a strongly maritime climate, and Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay are its leading wines.

blurb.text: Western Australia makes less than 5% of Australia's wine.
